title: Na alam na chacha
body:
na alam na chacha na shahe karbala
shaam hogayi
jo bhi ghar se gaya wo na phir aa saka
shaam hogayi
<<DIVIDER>>
raah takti rahi shiddate pyas mein
kat gaya din isi aas hi aas mein
koi aaya nahi jaane kya hogaya
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
<<DIVIDER>>
pani lene gaye dayr kitni huwi
din dhala ay chacha sham-e-gham aagayi
khushk hai ay chacha mera ab tak gala
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
<<DIVIDER>>
kisko aawaz doo huk ke maidaan mein
kaun hai jo sune is biyaban mein
de rahi hoo tumhe jaane kab se sada
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
<<DIVIDER>>
laut aao ke pani nahi chahiye
khao mujh par taras ab khuda ke liye
mashk khaali hi le aao ab to chacha
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
<<DIVIDER>>
jaa ke maidaan mein baba bhi aaye nahi
ab to jhoole mein asghar bhi haye nahi
qaima jalta hai yun jaise koi diya
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
<<DIVIDER>>
ro rahi hai phuphi chin gayi hai rida
maarte hai tamache mujhe ashkiyan
qaima jalta hai yu jaise koi diya
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu'on mein rasan baandhne aa gaye
khaynch ke legaye durr mere kaan se
hogaya khoon se tar saara kurta mera
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
<<DIVIDER>>
lo chacha suye zindan chali ghamzada
alvida alvida ay qateel-e-jafa
lijiye aap se ho rahi hoo juda
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha rehaan majlis mein sunke tera
chasme giriyan ko ye hosh kab hi raha
kab sahar hogayi aur kab dhin dala
shaam hogayi
na alam na chacha…
author: Rehaan Azmi
